post.meaning: The Master said: In teaching there should be no distinction of classes.
post.caption:
A line from Confucius that still holds 🎋

📖 Confucius, Analects, 15.39

उस एक इंसान को भेजें जिसे आज यह सुनना चाहिए। 💛

#confucius #confuciusquotes #wisdom #philosophy #quotes

reel.meaning: Shiva says: once you know the Lord's true nature, nothing appeals to you but loving him.
reel.caption:
महादेव की वाणी, आज के मन के लिए 🔱

📖 Tulsidas, Ramcharitmanas, Sundarkand 34 (Shiva to Parvati)

रोज़ एक वाणी के लिए Follow करें। 🙏

#mahadev #harharmahadev #shiva #bholenath #mahakal
